outcome.technical: THE WHOLE RECORD OF P169.3 (attempt 2; it replaces attempt 1's filing). WHAT THE TREE HOLDS. (a) The record. `_evidence_io`: RECORD_KEY `lastRun`. run_record builds the record from a row: runId, startedAt, durationMs, selectionMs, status, failed, verdictSource, reusedFrom, reuse key, gate digest, gateSource, leftToPhaseGate, banners, testedState {head, dirtyDigest, treeKey}, the machine and attribution lines, and launch. Each step keeps name, exit, ran, outcome, failing lines cut at MAX_FAILING, durationMs only when measured here, and reusedFrom when copied. A REUSED row copies its source's steps forward; steps are cut at MAX_STEPS with stepsDropped. Also pointer_from_record and record_stages. write_record takes the phase lock with a bounded wait (RECORD_WAIT_SECONDS), reads the shard UNDER the lock, and writes lastRun, testEvidence and the task's gate+selection timing stages in one save_plan_json. It releases the lock only if it took it, then writes the testEvidence journal row. subject_records reads every record; reconcile restores a pointer from the record when the ledger holds no newer row. The redaction report (_mio.report_redactions) sits directly beside each save in write_pointer and write_record. Attempt 1 had moved it into the shared journal-row helper, which turned tests/test__manifest_io.py ex6 red; ex6 is now green. (b) run-test-gate --record builds the record (_run_record_of) and calls write_record. A record that is not written prints `record: NOT written - this run is only in <ledger file>` and exits 3 on a green AND a red run, at every exit site (verdict, all-left, empty gate, --json). New --launch TOKEN is stored on the record. (c) _task_timing: whole_ms, stamp_less, run_stages, append_run_stages (once per kind+runId). drive-phase: row_stages delegates to run_stages; queue_row queues only the wait stage for a gate run, because the recorder appends gate and selection; it still says whose stage a repeated verdict's is, read off the stages built. (d) audit-task group sign-off copies the carrier's lastRun, or one built from its row, to each member with gradedBy. (e) Schema: $defs/lastRun, referenced from phase and task. _manifest_vocab: `lastRun` beside `testEvidence` in KNOWN_PHASE and KNOWN_TASK; the module holds no other key rule (no order, derived-class, carry or doc table; test__help_lints compares the same sets with the schema). (f) Demo generator. CORRECTION: attempt 1 said gen-demo-manifest and the committed examples were unaffected; that was WRONG. tests/test_gen_demo_manifest.py went red on the schema-coverage case, and this attempt fixes it. _stamp_pointers now writes each subject's lastRun through run_record and derives the pointer from it (`_recorded`). The rows now carry every field the demo honestly has a value for, each by the recorder's own derivation: gateSource (`_manifest_io.gate_entries`' answer, which the demo used to discard), gateDigest (`_evidence_io.gate_digest`), banners (`_banners_of`, compared with the real run-test-gate verdict_banners over every run by a new case), and startedAt (the run's stamp less its steps' length, through `_task_timing.stamp_less`). SCHEMA_EXEMPTIONS gains one row with its own reason for each field the demo has no honest value for: selectionMs (no selection is timed), verdictSource (absent means measured, and every demo run is one), reusedFrom (no repeated verdict), reuseKey (nothing runs the demo again), leftToPhaseGate (phaseGateOnly is not set), machine and attribution (nothing printed them), launch, gradedBy (no group sign-off) and stepsDropped (no gate past MAX_STEPS). New cases in test_gen_demo_manifest: the banners match the real function, with both arms present; every stamped subject carries run_record's record of its newest row with the derived pointer and the gate's source and digest; and the record pass agrees with the write pass. Mutations in a scratch copy: banners never produced -> that case red (139/140); a record naming another run -> the record case red (139/140); both restored. (g) Docs: COMPATIBILITY.md section 1 says lastRun is additive and does not change where a verdict is read from: a done task's commit trailers (section 3) first, else testEvidence; lastRun is the run the pointer names. Also CHANGELOG (Unreleased Added + Changed), manifest-conventions.md and PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md; the module map was regenerated (`python3 tools/lints/_deps.py --write-map`).
